python3 - <<'PY'
import json,re
from pathlib import Path
D=json.loads(Path('store/jobs/j000347/stdout.log').read_text()); n=b'userkey'; groups=[]
for it in D['hits']:
 p=Path(it['path']); b=p.read_bytes(); lower=b.lower(); contexts=[]
 for enc,q in [('ascii',n),('utf16le',b''.join(bytes([x,0]) for x in n))]:
  pos=0
  while (i:=lower.find(q,pos))>=0:
   a=max(0,i-80); z=min(len(b),i+len(q)+120); raw=b[a:z]
   # render bounded ascii and UTF-16 spans; redact long candidate-looking tokens and assignment values
   txt=raw.decode('latin1','replace').replace('\x00','')
   txt=re.sub(r'(?i)(userkey\s*[:=]\s*)[^\s,;\]}}]{1,128}',r'\1[redacted]',txt)
   txt=re.sub(r'\b[A-Fa-f0-9]{24,}\b','[long-hex]',txt)
   txt=re.sub(r'\b[A-Za-z0-9_+/=-]{32,}\b','[long-token]',txt)
   contexts.append(txt[:220]);pos=i+len(q)
 uniq=sorted(set(contexts))
 groups.append({'path':str(p),'matches':len(contexts),'sample_contexts':uniq[:3]})
print(json.dumps({'files':len(groups),'occurrences':sum(x['matches'] for x in groups),'contexts':groups},indent=2))
PY
